import json

def get_csr(mask):

    # CSR representation: data, indices, indptr
    # Since it's a binary mask, 'data' is just all True values
    rows, cols = np.where(mask)
    data = np.ones(len(rows), dtype=bool)
    indices = cols.astype(np.int32)
    
    H, W = mask.shape
    indptr = np.zeros(H + 1, dtype=np.int32)

        warped_f1 = cv2.warpAffine(f1, M, (W, H))
        diff = cv2.absdiff(warped_f1, f2)
        diff_gray = cv2.cvtColor(diff, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        _, mask = cv2.threshold(diff_gray, 30, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)

        kernel = np.ones((5,5), np.uint8)
        mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, kernel)
        mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_DILATE, kernel)
    else:
        mask = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)

    data, indices, indptr = get_csr(binary_mask)
    masks_data[f"f_{i}_data"] = data
    masks_data[f"f_{i}_indices"] = indices
    masks_data[f"f_{i}_indptr"] = indptr

masks_data[f"f_{last_idx}_data"] = data
masks_data[f"f_{last_idx}_indices"] = indices
masks_data[f"f_{last_idx}_indptr"] = indptr

with open('/root/pred_instructions.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(labels_dict, f, indent=2)
